sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic depth-0 gate: the verdict and the residue it leaves
sapience_notes.value: The depth-0 gate lifts in the POSITIVE direction on the step fragment, not via either of the two events originally filed. cellLE_zero_const_of_kappa_eq_stepFrag (FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/LadderStepFrag.lean) discharges CellLEZeroConstOfKappaEq for every StepFrag formula from ParamsOk at generic parameters, sorryAx-free. The refutation direction has NO depth-0 candidate: every separating family compiled anywhere in the tree (thetaC, sigC b, mixC a k, dblC j) is diaF- or .stab-rooted and so fails the schema's own stab-free hypothesis. The open residue is exactly the stab-free formulas carrying an UNBOUNDED U/S jump -- a guard other than bottom under an untl or a snce. The reserved name cellLE_zero_const_of_kappa_eq stays carried by no declaration.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic: the two owed threshold inequalities come from (K3) alone
sapience_notes.value: 2*(dBack phi + dFwd phi) <= Tc and <= Tn follow from ParamsOk through (K3)'s two conjuncts only -- (K2)'s margin arm is not needed and buys nothing. The one new piece of mathematical content is dBack_add_dFwd_le_closure_card: dBack counts snce-rooted closure members, dFwd counts untl-rooted ones, no member is both, so the two counts sit in DISJOINT filters of plusSubformulaClosure. From there k <= 2^k, 1 <= Fintype.card Q and card_prodState reach tShort Q phi. The snce/untl +1 cases need a no-self-containment step that FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/Subformulas.lean does not carry: a local structural size function (not sizeOf, whose atom arm reads Atom's own size) plus monotonicity along subformulas.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic (K4): the forward conjunct was one short and the asymmetry is forced
sapience_notes.value: paramsOkK4's forward conjunct read 2*dFwd phi + 1 <= B and now reads 2*dFwd phi + 2 <= B, with Bof's middle arm moved to match. The asymmetry against the backward arm (2*dBack) is FORCED, not conservative: LadderStepFrag.lean's module docstring point 2 derives the derived relation's gap clips from the one-step closure conditions Zrel_succ/Zrel_pred as G+ = 2a and G- = 2b + 2, so the asymmetry lives on the Zrel side and (K4) was the short side. The measurement that forced it is specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/ladder-step-fragment-gap-depth.lean's sigC family: BofPre_sigC = 2b+1 against Bof_sigC = 2b+2.

sapience_notes.subject: Repairing a definition that FALSIFIES landed theorems: the frozen-copy pattern
sapience_notes.value: When a definition repair makes landed records FALSE rather than merely unproved, the sanctioned route in BimodalLogic is a library-level frozen copy, not a deletion or a weakening. paramsOkK4Pre / ParamsOkPre / paramsOkPre_params were landed in CounterQuotient.lean, and each falsified record was restated against them with its WRITTEN CLIP UNCHANGED, plus a companion rejection record (not_paramsOkK4_thetaC_clip) saying the live predicate rejects that clip. One trap: a paramsOkPre_params stated at Bof cannot discharge the restatements, because after the repair Bof outputs a DIFFERENT value from the written clip -- it must be stated with the fourth argument written out as the PRE-REPAIR Bof body.

sapience_notes.subject: Bounded-block-edit hazard: a slice end index matched a prose citation of a section heading
sapience_notes.value: A multi-line markdown splice that computes its end index with s.index('## Section Name') searched from position 0 can match a PROSE CITATION of that section earlier in the file rather than the heading itself, putting the end index BEFORE the start index. The slice is then empty and the write SILENTLY DUPLICATES the whole region between them instead of erroring. Caught on task 991 in BimodalLogic: 115 duplicated plan-file lines, with the intended edit never applied. Two cheap guards: match both anchors at LINE START (l.startswith(...)) and assert end > start before writing. This is the concrete failure mode .claude/context/patterns/bounded-block-edit.md warns about.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic probe promotion: linter.style.show fires on promoted probe bodies
sapience_notes.value: A proof body promoted VERBATIM from a specs/evidence/ probe into FormalSystem/ can fail CI even though the probe compiles, because probes run through lake env lean WITHOUT the package's leanOptions while library modules get the full Mathlib syntax-linter set and CI builds --wfail. Concretely, Zrel_of_kappa_eq's three goal-restating `show` lines were flagged by linter.style.show (they restate Zrel's clauses with the two LadderState projections reduced, a definitional change); the idiomatic non-linted replacement is `change`. Separately, renaming a declaration to a longer name pushes docstring lines past the 100-character limit and files past their longFile baselines, and neither surfaces until the module rebuilds.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic git-commit-scoped.sh does not expand file_scope globs
sapience_notes.value: git-commit-scoped.sh's containment guard silently DROPS a pathspec that specs/state.json's file_scope covers only via a glob: an entry like specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/*.lean does not admit specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/ladder-cell-agreement-refutation.lean. The commit still succeeds, minus those files, with only a WARN line. The fix is to append the EXPLICIT paths to file_scope (re-serialising state.json with json.dump(..., ensure_ascii=False) to avoid corrupting non-ASCII already in the file) and re-run the commit. Verified on this repo at task 991 phase 5.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --check false ambiguity on probe-promoted names
sapience_notes.value: The advisory --check verdict reports 'resolves to more than one declaration' for every pinned identifier that exists both in its originating specs/evidence/ probe and in the library copy promoted from it -- four of five names on task 991. It reports no drift; it cannot compare at all. This is the known false-ambiguity defect the plan-compliance rule names, and it MUST NOT be read as a drift finding. Token-for-token signature agreement has to be confirmed separately, by #check on each landed declaration against the plan's Lean Challenge Statements block.
